title: Hover Emphasized Internal Node Borders
description: When a node is hovered, turn the internal borders of the node (between channels and vertical border between inputs and outputs) to emphasized color (same as text).
summary: Hovered nodes now paint internal chrome (column divider, channel row dividers, IO widget channel borders) with the same emphasized color as labels via `dag_node_internal_chrome_stroke`. Unhovered nodes keep the body stroke color.
